_: Off-season blurbs for the Teams view's form block (app.js renderTeamForm): shown before a season starts and once one is well over. Plain text, one per team slug. Edit freely — nothing generates this file.
bluejays: Creighton's season runs early November to March at the CHI Health Center, with the Big East tournament at Madison Square Garden and the NCAA tournament beyond it; the non-conference slate fills in over the summer.
mavericks: Omaha hockey runs early October to March at Baxter Arena, 17 or 18 home weekends, with the NCHC playoffs and the Frozen Four beyond that; the schedule is out by midsummer.
stormchasers: The Storm Chasers' International League season runs late March to September at Werner Park, 75 home dates in six-game series; the schedule is out by the autumn before.
lancers: The Lancers' USHL season runs late September to April at Liberty First Credit Union Arena in Ralston, 31 home dates, with the Clark Cup playoffs into May; the schedule arrives in July.
unionomaha: Union Omaha's USL League One season runs March to October at Morrison Stadium, 16 home matches, with the playoffs into November; the fixture list arrives over the winter.
